initialExam.title: IBPS RRB Office Assistant 2026
initialExam.description: Regional Rural Banks Office Assistant (Multipurpose) exam for clerical positions in rural banks. Notification expected Sep 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: Reasoning (40Q), Numerical Ability (40Q). Mains: Reasoning (40Q), Numerical (40Q), GK (40Q), English/Hindi (40Q), Computer (40Q).
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 80 questions, 80 marks, 45 min. Mains: 200 questions, 200 marks, 2 hours.
initialExam.jobRole: Office Assistant (Multipurpose) in Regional Rural Banks
initialExam.careerGrowth: Office Assistant → Officer Scale I through promotion.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit ibps.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
